messages:
Asha Nair: Quick pulse — can folks drop short updates for CS handoff?
- Kestrel: webhooks getting ~504s in EU; customer on Dedicated. I opened a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821
- Veridian: renewal flagged, CFO wants latency numbers (p95).
- LucidPay: embeddings drift after model pin visible on txn-matched rows.
Please do what I did / blockers / plan today.

Liam Park: Kestrel — dug into proxy logs, looks like nginx upstream timeout when bursts hit queue. I added a temporary 10s retry in the CS webhook proxy to reduce customer errors. Blocker: need ENG to adjust retry strategy and increase upstream keepalive on EU pool.
Example repro curl:
```
curl -v -H 'x-customer-id: kestrel-123' https://hooks.redwood.internal/kestrel/test
```

Marisol Gutierrez: Veridian — had renewal call yesterday, CFO wants SLA numbers. I exported p50/p95 for the last 7 days and uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/link-to-veridian-stats. Working on a one-pager for their CTO. Blocker: need ENG confirmation on expected p95 under Dedicated with current pool size.

Evan Cho: LucidPay — re-ran embeddings vs last pinned model; drift confined to currency formatting cases. Short-term: enabled fallback to previous embedding variant for LucidPay only, rolled as a canary. Blocker: need product sign-off to keep fallback for 48h while we investigate root cause.

Asha Nair: Thanks — @Liam can you loop eng-runtime and ask about keepalive/retry? @Evan I'll get product on this thread.

ops-bot: Incident INC-7892 created for Kestrel webhook 504s. Pager duty notified: @sre-oncall

Liam Park: Pinging eng-runtime: @Marc Huang any chance we can bump upstream keepalive to 30s for the EU pool? If not, can we add graceful queuing/backoff?

Marc Huang: Can do a quick bump during the low-traffic window. I'll schedule a config change at 10:30 UTC and add rate-limiter tuning after that. No blocker from runtime team.

Marisol Gutierrez: Adding Marc to the Veridian one-pager; Evan, cc'ing product (@Sara Lin) for sign-off.

Evan Cho: Sara approved the 48h fallback. I'll monitor canary and post metrics here (p50/p95 + error rate).

Asha Nair: Summary: Marc will bump keepalive at 10:30 UTC; Liam will follow up with retry/backoff patch for proxy; Evan holds the fallback for 48h; Marisol prepping Veridian one-pager for CTO. Re-check here at 11:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
